runs.name: Southwest Gas Holdings, Inc.; NYSE SWX, SEC CIK 0001692115, Delaware; Southwest Gas Corporation, regulated gas distribution to about 2.28 million customers in Arizona, Nevada and California; MountainWest sold 2023-02-14, Centuri deconsolidated August 2025
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **$87.45** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged; the 10-K's Item 5 gives $86.64 at 2026-02-18). Shares 72,445,853 common on the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (0001692115-26-000112, as of 2026-07-31), `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, against 72,443,899 issued and outstanding on that 10-Q's balance sheet, no treasury stock; Forms 4 and 144 only after the 10-Q. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (`tools/sources.py`, issuing authority). Read from the combined 10-K for FY2025 of Southwest Gas Holdings and Southwest Gas Corporation (0001692115-26-000062), the 10-Q to 2026-06-30, the proxy of 2026-03-23 (0001692115-26-000080), the 8-Ks (the Item 4.02 non-reliance of 2026-01-09, 0001692115-26-000004; the CEO resignation of 2026-02-25; the Icahn cooperation agreement of 2025-10-14, terminated 2026-02-11) and the 10-Ks for FY2019 to FY2023. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, ten lines stated in the run file; MountainWest (bought 2021-12-31 for $1.576B, sold 2023-02-14) and Centuri (IPO 2024-04-22, deconsolidated August 2025) treated as businesses no longer owned, their earnings out of the window and their proceeds in today's cash and debt; owner cash built from Southwest Gas Corporation's own filed statements. **Q1 IN**: one regulated gas distributor since August 2025, about 2.28 million customers in Arizona, Nevada and California, margin decoupled from volume, gas cost passed through. **Q2 IN, as the regulated exception**: a franchise network no attacker with money can duplicate, the 10-K's "large majority" of new homes in its metros in 2025; ordinary regulator-set returns carried to Q3 as a second best; state gas policy in California (12% of margin) and Nevada (35%) recorded as the strongest evidence against. **Q3 weighs against**: 3.9% to 6.2% after tax on all capital, 6.0% to 8.5% on equity, below every allowed return; spending 2.4 to 2.8 times depreciation; $752.6M put in by the parent. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against**: the June and September 2025 quarters declared unreliable for understated income tax ($27.3M and $35.1M), Southwest Gas Corporation's statements revised back to 2017, a material weakness in one tax control at Holdings; found and quantified by the company itself, the featured adjusted earnings below GAAP. **Q5 integrity IN, ability against**: MountainWest sold within 14 months with a $449.6M goodwill write-off and $50.0M more; earned returns below allowed; the CFO left in 2025 and the CEO resigned in 2026. **Q6 weighs against**: shares up 54% 2016 to 2025, $1.65B of stock sold against $1.37B of dividends, a dividend set partly by "the competitiveness of the dividend yield", pay on adjusted earnings and EPS, the departing CEO's 2025 retention award still vesting beside a $95,000-a-month advisory fee; no all-stock deal, so the narrower STOP not reached. **Q7 OUT on the floor**: owner cash 2021 to 2025 all-equity, after the company's own provision and a 24% tax on interest, the purchased-gas swing removed: $187.3M a year after maintenance (depreciation as the guess), -$263.8M after all spending, negative every year; not a serial acquirer, so no organic-pair figure. Expected return at the price 1.93% on the central case, 7.18% on the most generous case the run could build. Value range **-$35.65 to $0.77 a share** all-equity at the sovereign (equity-only -$27.04 to $23.48; literal window -$113.93); fair price **-$39.99 all-equity, not positive**, -$8.60 equity-only. Net debt $3,239.3M at 2026-06-30, $3,526.2M with the $286.8M gas over-collection counted as debt. Three CONVENTIONs of the run: the purchased-gas swing removed and the over-collection counted as debt; tax at the book provision with the operating-loss asset added at a present value of $131.7M; a 24% tax on interest. The 10-K names the electric utilities (unnamed) and interstate pipelines; filers used: Nevada Power and Sierra Pacific Power (from Berkshire Hathaway Energy's combined 10-K) and Northwest Pipeline LLC (from Williams's combined 10-K); non-filers flagged: El Paso Natural Gas, Kern River, Transwestern, Tuscarora, Ruby, Pinyon, Prospector. Net income over year-end equity: SWX 6.0% to 8.5%, Nevada Power 5.3% to 10.0%, Sierra Pacific 4.0% to 8.1%, Northwest Pipeline 11.7% to 15.9%. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing filtered to 2026-10-18 showing six run names (HOKCY, MDU, NJR, NWN, OGS, XNGSY), the OGS fold's commit subjects in the session context with a possible anchoring effect on the Q2 reading said so, and memory lines not naming SWX; none opened or used. Slips declared by the analyst: the Q7 arithmetic (`calc.py`, `calc_out.txt`) committed with Q1 in 6a8c78cc, before Q2 to Q4 closed, without the heading COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE (heading added at the close); a variant on net income plus after-tax interest shown beside the range as a robustness test only, setting no end and no reporting figure. **Dispatcher's note for the operator:** that variant is a net-income figure set beside the owner-cash range; operator rule 5 and the CONVENTION clause of PRIME RULE 3 bear on whether it may appear at all, even labelled. Commits a015f6c9 (template copy), 6a8c78cc (Step 0 and Q1), b1c22a3b (Q2), 9501c7a3 (Q3), d5177689 (Q4), d6a70153 (Q5), 47b0016e (Q6), ce330c6c (Q7 and the close; Q6's range line written back). Position note filled at the fold: not held; the operator-rule-ten self-audit line ticked at the fold. Citations: the analyst's `idcheck.py` 93 ids, 20 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` no E-ids, no missing id, 20 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): no rule for a pass-through balance or whether an over-collection owed to customers is net debt; specific (e) silent on whether growth spending grows with the business and stops at year ten; the cap's "sales" when revenue carries gas cost at cost; Whose tax on deferred tax from accelerated deductions and an indefinite federal NOL; the retention test for a business that retains nothing, serial issuance still a candidate STOP; the regulated exception leaving the floor at Q7 as a utility's only gate after integrity. Not armed: the all-equity fair is not positive and the run reports no organic-pair figure (not a serial acquirer); the equity-only figure is also negative. Could not get: price history for the market-value half of the retention test, finance-lease balances, Nevada Power and Sierra Pacific figures for 2016 to 2020 and 2023 equity, whether the 2020 gas-cost table includes accrued gas costs.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (Southwest Gas Holdings, NYSE SWX, regulated gas distribution in Arizona, Nevada and California since the Centuri separation; Q1 IN; Q2 IN as the regulated exception, a franchise network at ordinary regulator-set returns carried as a second best, state gas policy the strongest evidence against; Q3 against: 3.9% to 6.2% after tax on capital, spending 2.4 to 2.8 times depreciation; Q4 no STOP, against: 2025 interim quarters restated for tax, revision to 2017, a material weakness; Q5 integrity IN, ability against: MountainWest bought and sold within 14 months at a $449.6M goodwill loss, CEO and CFO turnover; Q6 against: shares up 54%, stock sold to fund dividends. Owner cash $187.3M a year after maintenance, negative after all spending every year; best case 7.18% at $87.45; value range -$35.65 to $0.77 a share all-equity at the 5.43% Treasury rate; fair price -$39.99 all-equity, not positive, -$8.60 equity-only; not armed. No citation slip; a net-income variant shown beside the range flagged for the operator under rule 5. Framework gaps for the operator: pass-through balances and net debt, (e)'s mechanics, the cap on pass-through revenue, deferred tax in Whose tax, retention where nothing is retained, the floor as a utility's only gate.)
